statement: ∀ (K : Type) [NontriviallyNormedField K] [CompleteSpace K] [IsUltrametricDist K], let theta := fun (q u : K) => ∑' n : ℤ, q^(n*(n+1)/2) * u^(2*n+1); ∀ q u : K, u ≠ 0 → q ≠ 0 → theta q u⁻¹ = theta q u
